title: Act: Write the temporary-asset replacement requirements document
description: Document each asset group with ids, sizes, frame counts and replacement rules, stating the art is temporary and not production quality.

steps.action: Write a doc beginning with: 'These assets are temporary and are not production-quality artwork.' Add headings Backgrounds, Furniture, Objects, Characters, Effects. Under each list manifest ids (background:wall, background:floor, background:window-view, background:lighting, scene:bedroom; objects/bed, objects/bookshelf, objects/desk, furniture:chair, furniture:wardrobe; objects/old-computer, objects/books, objects/door, objects/window, objects/secret-door-closed, objects/secret-door-open; character:boy, character:boy-walk, character:boy-interact; effect:dust, effect:glow) with required dimensions, frame size/count for sheets, SVG/PNG format and that replacements keep the same id and size or update the manifest.
steps.expected: File exists with all five headings and every id
